nodes.label: /console Command
nodes.rationale: Always replaces the running server rather than reporting a healthy one as fine: the server is detached and outlives its session, so claude plugin update leaves the OLD build serving on 4823 and a health check answers ok either way. Restarting is cheap because the console rebuilds its screen from its own append-only log. Kills by PORT, not plugin path - a path match once killed only the installed build while four locally-built servers accumulated, one of them happily answering /health. Starts the installed build regardless of whether a team is live, and reports a no-team start plainly so an empty wall does not read as broken.
